notes.title: Mirror Party Beta Testing Started Now!
notes.notes:

1. This BETA testing is not for Mirror 2, they are developed by different teams, whose work will not interfere with each other.

2. If you encounter any bug or have something you don't like, basically anything you want to say to us, please let us know directly. Emails are preferred, but we'll still check the Discord channels if you @KAGAMI WORKS OFFICIAL.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Mirror Party - A Gaiden of the Mirror Series Store Page Release
notes.notes:
A huge crisis broke out in the Mirror-verse. In the name of justice (or probably mischief), the bishojos went to war! Select your heroine and fight! The mini-game collection of Mirror-verse: Mirror Party. 

This is the first time we try to develop a game that combined minigames and collectibles. Play the minigames with your friends and families to get the Gacha Tokens, throw them in the Gacha Machine, and get OVER 300 pieces of collectibles: CGs/Cosplay Album/Video/OST, and more! 

[i]※The game is in Early Access. We plan to eventually increase minigames to 12 ones and collectibles 1000+. [/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787820/Mirror_Party/

[h3]Recent Update of the Development of Mirror 2: [/h3]

We know that many of you are concerned with the recent development of Mirror 2. 

We'd like to thank you for your support! We've been reading every review that you posted since day 1 Mirror was released. We value your input and feedback on this game very seriously. 

Early-stage into the development of Mirror 2, we immediately felt how challenging it is to switch from 2D to 3D technical-wise. It's so much more than we initially expected. We're kinda like toddlers trying to learn how to run like Usain Bolt. 

But we carried on, we've found the power to push us through the difficulties a long time ago - We just want to make a fun game, it's simple as that. All the pain, sweat, and hardship are just a part of the journey. We're still in the process of leveling up, we're still trying to clear the obstacles, we're learning new stuff every day. So we have to apologize, that Mirror 2 needs more time to polish before we can show it to you all. 

But the good news is, although having many obstacles, we've done something right and some part of the game already looks pretty good. It's not as pretty as we'd like it to be, but still, we managed to make a formal trailer, so you can have a basic understanding of how the game is going to be like. We hope you can see our passion and love for the game. And we'd like to hear what you would like to say about our progress so far. 

Thank you again for your love and support over the years. And still, we're going to the best we can! 
[previewyoutube=mmYS6_E98E4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Important Decisions about Mirror 2 Kickstarter Campaign
notes.notes:
Greetings, my fellow gamers! 

It's a pity that our Kickstarter campaign didn't end with a better result. But still, we'd like to take a bow and say thank you to all of you who've backed us in our campaign, and those who weren't able to. We got over 3,000 backers when it ended. 

We appreciate your support very much! And to show our appreciation, we have made the following decisions: 

We promise, that though the Kickstarter funding failed, [b]we'll carry on and work even harder on the development of Mirror 2[/b]. 

[b]Everyone who backed us, no matter if you have canceled or not, will get a copy of Mirror 2 and all the DLCs, FOR FREE. [/b]That includes character, music, wallpaper DLCs and etc. Everything we can make, anything you'll have. They will be sent to you in the form of Steam Activation Keys when we're ready, please stay tuned! 

Besides all this, everyone who's backed us can enter our Discord server in the "backer" role, which will allow you to enter a private channel, where you can learn about our [b]newest progress, become our exclusive pre-alpha, alpha and beta testers and entitle to other privileges. [/b]

If you didn't participate in our campaign but would still want to know about the development and to become a beta tester, please join us on Discord as well: https://discord.gg/mkymRsz , follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/kagamiworks]@kagamiworks[/url] and subscribe to our YouTube channel: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCiUy7YxBoa3A5CYRRdGxyzQ]KAGAMI WORKS[/url]. 

We can't say thank you nearly enough to all of you who love Mirror! We'll devote 200% of ourselves to the development of Mirror 2. Please stay tuned for more!
(As the rules of Kickstarter stated, if a project fails to reach the goal, the pledge will not be deduct from your account)

notes.title: Q&A of Project Mirror 2 on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Our project on Kickstarter has over 1300 backers and have pledged over 26k dollars! All thanks to your love and support! We've also received many questions about the project. You'll find most of them answered in the Q&A.

[b][list] 1. Why $500,000? Did you guys mess up the numbers? It seems awfully hard to reach. [/list][/b]
We've received your concerns regarding this matter almost from day 1. We understand that half a million is a lot to ask for, but ask any developer, 3D game development extremely funds consuming. For example, each piece of garment is a separate model and would cost us as much as the modeling of a character. And in the end, we'd like to bring you a game as flawless as it can get. It's a challenge to reach the goal, we understand it, but so is developing this game. But we're facing the challenges head-on and will not ever back down.
[b][list]2. Why 3D? I want a 2D game! [/list][/b]
We understand that the previous game, Mirror, was loved by you all with its unique 2D art style, we'd like to thank you all for the love and support over the years. 
As an indie developer, it's important to challenge ourselves on a regular basis and break out of our comfort zone. And the impact and expressive of a good 3D game showed us more possibilities. We'd like to show our audience the worlds we imagine as immersive and impactful as they can get, like how blown away we were when we play Detroit: Become Human for the first time. We hope that this would let you feel like the characters and get in touch with the beauty in our worlds.
[b][list]3. What's the price? [/list][/b]
Our CURRENT plan for pricing on Steam in USD is:

Mirror 2				$9.99 
Character DLC			$9.99
OST DLC          	$1.99
Theme Song DLC		$1.99
Art Book DLC			$1.99
Wallpaper DLC			$1.99
Cosplay Album DLC 	$1.99
Emoji DLC  			$0.00
RingTone DLC  		$0.00

※Pricing may vary when using different currencies. 

[b][list]4. Will this be only a 3D remake of the previous game or there will be new characters? [/list][/b]
No, this is not a remake. There are new characters in the game as well as characters from the previous game since you all love them so much. But the stories will be utterly different. They will be connected with the stories in the previous game, but the storyline will either be a prequel, sequel, or gaiden.

[b][list]5. Wechat Pay/AliPay, please! [/list][/b]
We apologize for the inconvenience. Since Kickstarter do not support those payment method mentioned above and is not likely to add them to the list any time soon, it's most likely that there's no way for us to add other payment methods without breaking any rules or laws. Sorry!

If you have more questions, please join our Discord server: discord.gg/mkymRsz
Please fund our project on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/indieworld/mirror-2-0

notes.title: Mirror 2 On Kickstarter NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]The official Sequel of Mirror! Now in development! Fully evolved from 2D to 3D! [/b]

Please fund our project on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/indieworld/mirror-2-0 

After April 2018, the release date of Mirror on Steam, we’ve received overwhelming love and support from millions of fans. We’ve got 40,000+ reviews and 97% of them are recommending the game. While it’s a great achievement of our career, we grew unease more and more after some time.

So we decide to take the challenge up a notch. After the release of Mirror, we decided to start again, almost from scratch, developing Mirror 2 based on 3D modeling and real-time rendering. It’s extremely difficult to transform from 2D to 3D, we’re facing tons of technical challenges. Schedules being scratched, animation being reworked on, all of this would not be for waste when we have the fine, finished product to show for. It’s been two years of hard work, and finally we have something exciting to show you the sweat and pain, heart and sincerity we devoted in this project.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30293231/59fab10a7260f03f80fef8428acb80b256f1441c.jpg[/img]
We sincerely hope that you, our supporter and the source of power that kept us going, would find a better self in this game, like we did.

notes.title: Mirror Maker Update 2.1.1
notes.notes: Fixed the bug that caused the game freeze on the main title when WindowsOS is in Russian.

notes.title: Update Node 2.1.0
notes.notes:
1. Added more detailed tutorial. 
2. Fixed the bug that caused the game freezes in the Start screen.

notes.title: Update Node 2.0.0
notes.notes:
1. Tags in Workshop is now activated and RESOURCE TYPE tag is added to the mix. You can find the resources MOD under that tag. 
2. Deleted the "Shop" function in the editor so that you don't have to buy those first anymore. 
3. More space for improvization. You now can choose what skill to use for Lv2 and Lv3 gems. 
4. Added Match-3 Battle editing function. 
You can make your own battle phase from now on. 
5. New Resource Mod Type
You can now create resources MOD, which will open a folder for you to put everything you want to upload, please note that the quantity should be more than 1 but less than 1000. 
6. Regular bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that caused infinite loading when replaced a pic.
2. Fixed the bug that caused the app to freeze when imported some large files.
3. Fixed the bug that caused the app to freeze when imported some pics.
4. Fixed the bug that caused some music file to be unreadable.

notes.title: Update V1.1.1
notes.notes:
1. Partially open battle part for your to edit. You can now edit basic player data and basic enemy data. Enemy AI is not changable for the moment.
2. Now support 32-bit system.
3. Optimized the experience in windowed mode.
4. Optimized memory usage.
5. You can shift to the resource list according to the buttons below you click.

If you need instruction in the editor, please click the button on the top right cornor for help.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
1. Unlocked the 4 DLC characters. You can now download them in Workshop. 
2. Minor bug fixes and performance optimizatons.

notes.title: Mirror Maker Update V1.0.1
notes.notes:
1. Optimized UI, added hovering and clicking effects of some buttons. Importing official script is now more easier. 
2. Added cloud saves to all mods. 
3. Added copy function to right click menu of the paragraph. 
4. Fixed the delete button. 
5. Added a refresh button, so after you download mods from the workshop you don't need to restart the game. 

About future development: 
We're very sorry that the current version is not very big on functions. We just wanted to let you know what the core concept this editor would be but the content and function will definitely double or even triple in the final version. In the future, we'll: 
1. unlock battle scenes for modding, you can replace gems, icons, portraits and sound effects. 
2. add resource pack for you to use for free, there will be packs for art, music and etc for modding.
